text: Searching online for a product or information, you expect objective, relevant results, believing the internet a neutral source.
A friend suggests: "Try Incognito for unbiased results!" You open a private window, shedding your history for a fresh start.
You type the exact same query. The results are different. You wonder if a hidden cookie or cached page is tricking you.
The system knows. Even in Incognito, your IP, device, browser, and location are visible. These create a temporary, personalized profile for search engines.
This unseen system tailors your results, showing what it thinks you want, not always the objective best. Your personalized bubble follows you into "private" mode.
Next time you compare options or research, remember Incognito isn't a blank slate. You're still navigating a world shaped for you.
